notes.title: Major update - Comprehensive Upgrade of Gameplay
notes.content: The game has been completely redone, changing the original top-down perspective mode to FPS mode, adding multi-player online functions, and the basic logic and gameplay have been fully upgraded. It integrates interstellar exploration, survival construction, and FPS combat.
